value.rationale: The cubic endpoint is the first nonlinear natural member of the sharp finite-field moment-curve extension family. Its optimal universal stability coefficient was missing from a published all-d bound explicitly nonsharp in d>2; the new exact sum-of-squares and two equality types show that sparse boundary data, not local Hessian curvature, is the extremal obstruction. This is an exact natural sharp invariant for all allowable field sizes, not an arbitrary finite example or routine increment.
